WHY EVERY LADDER ROUTE FAILED. D(y_1) alone carries the entire volume, but summed over the Galois orbit D cancels IDENTICALLY -- y_2 = conj(y_1) with D(conj z) = -D(z), and the real root gives 0. D is exactly the regulator the ordinary Bloch group computes, so that whole apparatus evaluates to zero on a Galois-summed dilogarithm and can carry no information about A. This is general (conjugate symmetry, every number field), which is why Routes 1-5, 40 and 41 could not have closed
